task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in src/report_gen.py so all 5 tests pass.

  def ensure_report_dir(base_dir, report_name):
    — never creates the directory (missing os.makedirs call)
    — fix: add `if not os.path.isdir(report_dir): os.makedirs(report_dir)` before the return

  def write_html_report(report_dir, title, rows):
    — uppercases the title: title.upper() should be title
    — fix: change title.upper() to title in the html string

  def delete_report(report_dir):
    — always returns False without deleting anything
    — fix: check for and remove report.html, return True if deleted else False

Do not modify the test file.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: write_html_report uses title as-is not uppercased
delete_report actually deletes report.html and returns True/False
success_criteria: uv run python -c "from src.report_gen import write_html_report, read_report" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
